description: The one capability for the main window: the Tauri core defaults ONLY. No fs, no shell, no http, no process plugins are installed at all — the updater plugin IS installed, and it grants the webview NOTHING: the Rust core owns the check and the install, and the renderer only ever sees a DTO; the webview reaches the kernel over the pinned loopback origin through the page's own fetch, never through Tauri.
